text:
passion part deux / "il buono, il brutto, il cattivo"

the good, the bad, and the ugly

(1/4)

the simplest visualization I can think of as far as passion, tying back to the QT, is say a 20-year old college kid and a 60-year old professor...there is no age, there is no barrier.

the subject could be physics, or the final days of the Roman republic, or Byron and Shelley... but u have two ppl united by intense interest in a subject

no more no less

just a few humans, "puzzle solvers," engrossed in the mysteries of the universe or of human nature.

(2/4)

I have to emphasize the Druck quote (QT'ed in the QT) - passion is a mix of latent talent and mentorship.

so if u dont have it right now, u ain’t hopeless. 

for me, I had nothing at age 20-21...mentors unlocked it in me. I've been stuck ever since, I can't escape it lol. I went back to business school to see what else was out there, and realized "why would I want to do anything else, markets are all I think about"

and then after that, a lot of doors began opening...just shooting the shit with ppl, many of whom happened to be way higher up/richer/more powerful than me, but it was never that...like the 20/60 yr old example, it was just two ppl, ageless, with an all-consuming obsession for mkts + love of the game. that's passion and it cant be faked

a billionaire isn't a billionaire in that context. age disappears....two ppl solving puzzles.

(3/4)

now that I'm older I see it in reverse, with young guys just barging into my DM’s -- no "hello," just like 7 straight DMs on some market shit they dont get. thats how it goes, thats how I was lol. there's no need for the formalities...passion is passion my man...lets build.

but u gotta be aware...there is a dark side of passion.

"problems with relationships."

I used to interpret this as "socially dysfunctional" but its not, I've met a lot of these ppl now...they are driven not by money but by sheer 24/7 obsession, and while they are functional socially, its a prioritization thing.

(4/4)

they are one-track minded, hyperfocused, they want to solve the puzzle and win the game, and a lot of times, other people are a drag on their time...they're in the lab on some mad scientist shit.

"be a good husband/father" is important to them, it brings them fulfillment, but their passion is the truly all-encompassing thing.

whether they care, or are even aware of all of this, is above my paygrade...its the interplay of virtue and vice, its uncontrollable

passion is passion, obsession is obsession.

are they "wrong," maybe, idk...its not our place to judge or tell another man how to live his life. should musk take humanity to mars or should he be domesticated at home? because he cant do both. 

leave it in Gods hands...

END

passion dictates the path of ur life

it is a gift, very few have it. if u do, u are blessed to have a passion, blessed to have a deep interest in something that brings u joy and fulfillment.

but if u feel u possess some degree of this mad scientist archetype, just be aware of how sharp that double-edged sword can be.

the same passion that will carry u to new heights, will also be the catalyst for each and every one of ur stumbles... because "your greatest weakness is often your greatest strength taken too far."

stay hungry, stay humble ⚔️

quotedTweet.text:
passion really is the great equalizer

if you have it, there is no conversational barrier between a 20-year old apprentice and a 60-year old master...pure love of the game breaks those walls down

but as for whether its born or bred, I don't know - this QT is the best I've found
